# Dragoon's Town v0.19

This update expands the existing town into a longer-running business empire and preserves existing saves.

- Better screen fit in portrait and landscape, evolving business details, natural estate/home/vehicle illustrations and optional town activity.
- Buy 1/10/25/50/100/1K, next milestone or maximum; maximum-affordable purchases across collections and markets; estate staff upgrades.
- Wider business milestones, conservative long-term income growth and prestige beginning at one quadrillion. Earned bonuses and existing holdings are preserved.
- Statistics, progression information, offline capacity upgrades and improved backup/restore protection.
- Six districts and twelve ventures, configurable managers with reserves, optional supply chains and permanent prestige talents.
- Rental portfolios, commercial fleets, vehicle paint, town decorations, reputation, contracts, achievements and optional events.
- Regional towns and headquarters provide continuing late-game goals. Simulations now cover a year; progression varies with play schedule.

Districts currently share the coastal map. Separate district scenery and physical-device performance checks remain future work. No real payments, ads or real financial trading.

Android: compatible update for the existing app, version code 8, minimum Android 7. Install through More → App updates → Check now. Do not uninstall; your save stays on the device. Android 13 remains supported.

The shared source passed gameplay, financial/save regression and six Chrome layout checks. Android preview assembly and native unit tests passed before release; the release workflow also verifies the original signing certificate, package, version and downloaded APK bytes.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
